summary: The proof is complete and correct. The strict-range tail inequality extends continuously to a+c=2 with all hypotheses preserved. The endpoint geometric reduction correctly converts every nonhorizontal halfspace through (1,g) to the tail constraint aw_0+cw_2=2 and separately verifies both horizontal halfspaces. The planar centroid bound follows from the accepted tent decomposition and affine minorant. Brunn-Minkowski equality yields the claimed common-shape normalization, while the height shear, common translation, and height reflection preserve slice mass and halfspace depth. The complementary case a^2>=1+c^2 is correctly handled at the centroid of the larger outer slice using the planar 4/9 bound.
